lithos_version: lithos 0.4.0 @ 917cb5d for the success payload and its legacy variant; the id-prefix envelopes (T3-W8) are lithos 0.6.0 @ d2c49bb (source read 2026-10-05) — the resolver call reached this tool with the short-prefix feature (8ce96bd, lithos #412), first released in 0.5.0

request.notes: `task_id` goes through the SHARED resolver (`resolve_task_id`, field `task_id`) before the lookup (`tools/tasks.py:1200` @ d2c49bb): a value of 36 or more characters is a full id and passes through untouched, a miss included, to this tool's own `task_not_found` ("Task '<id>' not found."); anything shorter than `MIN_PREFIX_LEN` (6) is `invalid_input`; anything between is searched as a PREFIX — matching nothing is the resolver's own `task_not_found` ("No task matches id prefix …", same code, different message) and matching several is `ambiguous_id_prefix` (`AmbiguousIdPrefixError`, mapped by `tool_span`) with up to `AMBIGUITY_CANDIDATE_CAP` (5) `{id, title}` candidate RECORDS. A unique prefix answers the matched task, whose `id` is the FULL id — Lens's relation confirm step (T3-W8) posts that id, never the prefix typed.
